$comment: Kill effects (docs/17 §3.7, docs/04 §7 and §8.7): what plays where a victim falls when the killer's equipped skin line carries one, on kills with that gun. Everyone who can see the spot sees it; it starts on the kill event and nothing waits for it. Limits (test/weaponSkins.test.ts, apps/web render3d/test/skins.test.ts): durationS ≤ 1.0; `particles` (shards + sparkles + swirl) ≤ 80, all quads from the shared VFX atlas in one instanced draw call; the body's tint runs in the victim's own draw call; everything inside the body envelope (base body box +10%); no light past it and nothing brighter than the victim's lit body (`bodyTint` mixes into the toon colour, it never adds light). `dissolveS`: the body dissolves over this window (seconds after the kill), sooner than a plain death's fade (0.4–0.65 s), so its shards take its place. The phases: `shards` (crystal cubes, the atlas's Shard cell) hang where the body stood as it tints and collapses, burst out a little, tumble and shrink away; `sparkles` (the Star cell) twinkle in two waves, the second at `secondWaveS`; `swirl` (Dot and Star motes) starts at `atS` and rises in a two-strand spiral of `radiusM`, `turns` times round over its life, `riseM` up. `palette`s are picked per quad, so a colour listed twice comes up twice as often (the Galaxy Relic's violet, magenta and teal, a touch of gold). `still`: the variant for Reduce flashes, Reduce motion, the Low preset and a fifth effect at once: the body fades with a flat tint over the same time, no particles. `sound`: none yet (the base death sound plays).
